-- Smoke test for the wasm32-built batteries bundle.
-- batteries is the largest non-stub project we've built end-to-end:
-- 173 oleans (.olean / .olean.private / .olean.server / .ir / .ilean) packed
-- to ~75 MB. Importing it from a user file proves cross-compile + bundle
-- + CDN + IDE consumption all work at production-shape paths.

import Batteries

open Batteries

#check @Batteries.HashMap
#check @Batteries.RBMap
#check @Batteries.AssocList
